_comment: Audio/video 180 hold: each viewer subscribes catalog, video and audio on one session. Publisher is external: pub_bench --video 720p -r 30 -g 60 --audio --catalog -t 480 (namespace aiomoqt; tracks video ~2.19 Mbps in 2 s GOPs, audio 341 B at 46.875/s, catalog 512 B at 1/s, one object per group for both). Run load_sim --role sub -f av-viewers.json; duration must equal pub_bench -t. Join shape matches the video-only 180 hold.
